_doc: Cross-repo consumption status for every adopted lever with a non-zero declared value. Reviewed by hand 2026-09-22 by CALL-PATH TRACE, not grep. consumed = the nfl2 money path reads this key; production_side = consumed in nfl-predictions before nfl2 runs; shadowed = nfl2 implements the same concept with its OWN literal/default, so the declared value is ignored even though the behaviour happens (currently equal, unguarded); dead = declared here and not consumed by the money path. A new non-zero lever with no entry fails the test. off = declared 0 and therefore inert. EVERY lever needs an entry: value-based filtering is unsafe, because OWN_MODEL is declared '' and '' SELECTS the naive fade rather than disabling it -- the very defect this guard exists for. Found by mutation M1, 2026-09-22. needs_production_confirmation = declared '' and unread by nfl2; only production knows whether '' is inert or selects a default.
